constraints.text: City base is Tokyo only. No Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, or Ghibli Park as the first-city base.
13 nights: Tokyo 3 + Yomase ski 6 + Tokyo or other city 4.
Ski week from Yomase. Closest hill Ryuoo, then Shiga Kogen, then Nozawa ~30–40 min. Madarao as an alt.
Tokyo lodging both ends is not booked. One building for the group is the working idea — not a hold.
